question: Do iPhone 11 owners report smooth operation, slowdowns, or freezing?
answer:
One iPhone 11 owner reported that the phone runs great and that playing Call of Duty on high graphics settings runs smoothly without much heating. [1a8dc2437421_1]
Another reviewer said their refurbished iPhone 11 is working great. [efbceff468f0_0]
One owner stated the iPhone 11 performs good overall and works good. [bd5e1fe37f3e_0]
A reviewer who received a bad iPhone 11 said it was stuck on the startup Apple logo for 20 minutes and crashed over and over, with Apple reporting a hardware problem. [749594d30dc7_0]
One owner reported that after three days the iPhone 11 completely restarted without warning up to 10 times in an hour and sometimes did not respond to touch for several moments. [6c19839404bd_0]
Another reviewer returned their iPhone 11 because it kept restarting about 15 times in one night. [478306f8e4b0_0]

chunks.text: Facial recognition works perfectly the cameras are normal the way it is on any iphone 11 and also runs great. I play cod on it quite a but and it runs smoothly on high graphic settings and doesn’t heat up much either. Also delivered a few days earlier than estimated.
Iphone. Bought a refurbished IPhone 11 and is working grest

Received bad iPhone. When I received my iPhone 11 and started it up, it was stuck on the startup Apple logo for 20 minutes. I was finally able to log in when it crashed, over and over. I contacted Apple to troubleshoot it and they said there was a problem with the hardware. I don’t see a way to talk to anyone at this company so I’m returning it.

Connectivity Issues, Random Restarts, and Touch Screen Problems. After having this iphone 11 for just 3 days, I've come to realize that there are issues with the phone that were not addressed before it was sent to me. After fully resetting and updating the phone, checking the sim card with my service provider, and even taking it to multiple phone repair shops to have it checked... The phone still completely restarts without any warning up to 10 times in an hour. The device also seems to have some screen sensitivity issues and sometimes it will not respond to touch for several moments before working. On top of that, this phone hasn't been able to locate any of the bluetooth devices in my home that other members of the household are easily able to connect to.
Poor Battery Life.. Battery life isn't very good. Maybe this is a common problem with iPhone11 in general though, I'm not sure.
For iPhone 11. Was not good had to return it because it kept restarting about 15 times in one night was not happy

Black screen. I am not happy with the IPhone 11, the screens goes black and it’s hard to get it back
Iphone 11. i live it and it’s reliable
